sections.title: History
sections.content:
Fei comes from a middle-class family in the kingdom of Krung-go, a prosperous land hidden within the mists of the eastern seas of Grand Gaia. Even though he had good looks, he doesn't take to any of the girls recommended to him by his parents. During a hunting trip one day, Fei meets Fang, and soon, he falls in love with her wild yet innocent personality. Fei then guids Fang in many aspects of the hunt and even the ways of acting like a woman.

One day, when Fei and Fang are wandering the unexplored wilds, The Witch of Abyss, Xie'Jing, observes them. The witch falls to Fei's good looks and schemes to seduce him. Xie'Jing then abducts and imposes as Fang. When Fei interacts with her, he feels something amiss and keeps questioning the imposter. When Xie'Jing finally reveals herself, she is angered by Fei's frantic threats to get Fang back. As a final resort, Xie'Jing puts a curse on Fei, turning him into a mindless doll who only obeys Xie'Jing's commands. Some time after that, Fang comes to rescue Fei, killing the Witch of Abyss and breaks the curse she put on him. After they exchange the vow to never leave each other's side anymore, the couple moves far away from the capital city of Krung-go, and lives a simple but happy life. Soon after their marriage, they are blessed with a beautiful daughter.

Several years after Feng's birth, Xie'Jing is regaining her power deep in the forest, and causes Fei to have nightmares in his sleep. He then decides to depart with Fang to stop the vengeful spirit of Xie'Jing to regain her form, but then the Witch of Abyss corners him and his wife. That is when Feng comes to rescue them from the clutches of the mad witch, along with the witch's son. After they stop Xie'Jing's resurrection, Fei lets Feng to embark the journey together with Long.

'''Fei''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is the husband of [[Fang (character)|Fang]] and the father of [[Feng (character)|Feng]].

==Debut Appearance==
As an NPC character, Fei first appears in the Festive Event, [[Witch of the Abyss:Dungeon|Witch of the Abyss]].

==History==
Fei comes from a middle-class family in the kingdom of Krung-go, a prosperous land hidden within the mists of the eastern seas of Grand Gaia. Even though he had good looks, he doesn't take to any of the girls recommended to him by his parents. During a hunting trip one day, Fei meets [[Fang (character)|Fang]], and soon, he falls in love with her wild yet innocent personality. Fei then guids Fang in many aspects of the hunt and even the ways of acting like a woman.

One day, when Fei and Fang are wandering the unexplored wilds, The Witch of Abyss, [[Xie'Jing (character)|Xie'Jing]], observes them. The witch falls to Fei's good looks and schemes to seduce him. Xie'Jing then abducts and imposes as Fang. When Fei interacts with her, he feels something amiss and keeps questioning the imposter. When Xie'Jing finally reveals herself, she is angered by Fei's frantic threats to get Fang back. As a final resort, Xie'Jing puts a curse on Fei, turning him into a mindless doll who only obeys Xie'Jing's commands. Some time after that, Fang comes to rescue Fei, killing the Witch of Abyss and breaks the curse she put on him. After they exchange the vow to never leave each other's side anymore, the couple moves far away from the capital city of Krung-go, and lives a simple but happy life. Soon after their marriage, they are blessed with [[Feng (character)|a beautiful daughter]].

Several years after Feng's birth, Xie'Jing is regaining her power deep in the forest, and causes Fei to have nightmares in his sleep. He then decides to depart with Fang to stop the vengeful spirit of Xie'Jing to regain her form, but then the Witch of Abyss corners him and his wife. That is when Feng comes to rescue them from the clutches of the mad witch, along with [[Long (character)|the witch's son]]. After they stop Xie'Jing's resurrection, Fei lets Feng to embark the journey together with Long.
